name: Monte Carlo Voxelization with Ray-Casting Optimization
definition: An algorithm to approximate the geometric similarity (Bv) between a voxel and a 3D object by sampling points within the voxel using rays, avoiding full volumetric intersection tests.
summary: Monte Carlo Voxelization with Ray-Casting Optimization approximates voxel-object similarity by sampling points within columns using rays, significantly reducing computational cost through optimized occupancy checks and spatial acceleration.
